text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... don't waver...
I have to reach the other side, no matter what—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This dream again...
When will I finally be able to cross over to the other side...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Plagued by nightmares, Manhattan Cafe ended up staying up late...
